B "resources.ts" subtitle "Typed references, inputs, secrets".

D "GraphQL schema + documents" subtitle "Explicit public API and selections".
Middle big boundary titled "Contract validation + generation — npm run contract". Show four stages in exact execution order linked left-to-right by dashed violet arrows:
"framework:generate" → "Database contract emit" → "GraphQL Codegen" → "Consumer typechecking".
